checks.title: The sync check of an application

rules.pass: The relay is synced (within 2 blocks of its peers), has block 2, and its API listens beyond loopback.
rules.warn: The relay is synced, but its API listens on loopback only.
rules.fail: The relay is still syncing, is more than 2 blocks behind, or lacks block 2.
rules.unknown: The peers, the API or the sockets could not be read.
rules.skipped: This host does not run a relay.

advice.ready: The relay is synced at height {height}. The tip is {tip_id}; block 2 is {block_2_id}; the API listens beyond loopback. The text to sign comes with the application rules. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#onboarding-sync-proof.
advice.loopback-only: The relay is synced at height {height}, but its API listens on loopback only, so the application check cannot reach it. The check must reach this API for about 10 minutes. Use a sentry, or open the API port to the checker's address only for the check, then close it again. The text to sign comes with the application rules. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#onboarding-sync-proof.
advice.not-ready: The relay is not ready for the application check: it is {behind} blocks behind its peers (syncing: {syncing}; block 2 served: {has_block_2}). Wait until it is synced and run the doctor again. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#onboarding-sync-proof.
